title: Kalshi Platinum: Supporting our trader community
summary: Kalshi Platinum gives its most active traders a dedicated service team. Eligibility is based on volume alone, with responsible trading built in.
body_markdown:
As Kalshi’s trader community has grown to millions, our most active traders should have access to extra support and services, like they do at other financial institutions such as Interactive Brokers, CME and Charles Schwab.


Kalshi Platinum gives our most active traders, professionals and institutional clients a dedicated service team. The purpose of the program is to assist traders with their trading journey, help them access our diversity of services and tools (data, API, Kalshi Prime, etc.), promote the use of risk management tools and reward them for their loyalty and business with Kalshi.


The program’s eligibility is based on trading volume alone, never on somebody’s performance in the market. Markets benefit from volume and liquidity because they make them more efficient and improve pricing accuracy. Just like the CME, our business model is transaction fees on volume.


Tens of thousands of traders qualify for Platinum today. On average, our Platinum members are profitable on Kalshi.


## **How we support traders**


Traders who qualify for the Platinum program are extremely dedicated and use Kalshi often. Our benefits are meant to ensure their needs are met and that they’re experiencing all Kalshi has to offer. We aim to provide a seamless customer experience that our traders deserve.


Platinum benefits look like those at a brokerage or a bank’s private client desk:


-


Dedicated, faster customer support with a human touchpoint


-


Expedited withdrawals


-


Access to higher deposit limits, only after passing financial and credit checks


-


Invitations to curated networking events


-


Personal onboarding and tooling support


## **The principles of the program**


-


**Risk management and Responsible Trading come first.**


-


We always start by educating traders on our risk management tools to minimize any unhealthy trading behaviors. Platinum customers receive


**[Responsible Trading resources](https://kalshi.com/policy-center/responsible-trading)**


every two months.


-


Customers with Responsible Trading restrictions, like self-imposed limits or self-exclusion, are never invited to Platinum. This check happens before any outreach.


-


**We never target people based on losses.**


-


Since Kalshi is a financial exchange and not a sportsbook, we don’t make money when people lose. We never use a customer’s wins or losses to decide whom we contact, invite or market to. As a competitive marketplace, we never use predatory incentives because our incentives are not predatory.


-


We don’t offer money back on losses or a bonus offer because a customer lost. A losing streak is never a trigger for an incentive to keep trading.


-


**Proactive risk management support and clear escalation.**


Concerning conversations go straight to Responsible Trading specialists. Any sign of risk to a customer’s safety goes to senior support, compliance and legal immediately, and crisis resources are provided.


-


**Trained people.**


Every customer-facing team completes Responsible Trading training each year. Our specialists train under the Financial Trader Health and Safety Initiative, in partnership with Birches Health and NCPG.
